payload.title: Validating a Reconstruction
payload.description: This notebook validates a paleoclimate reconstruction by comparing it to the original LMRv2.1 reconstruction and multiple instrumental datasets. The validation process involves assessing global mean surface temperature comparisons, climate field skill metrics, and ensemble similarity using the plume distance framework.

steps.title: Load LMRv2.1 Data

steps.title: Plot LMR Comparison

steps.description: Apply the plume distance framework to quantitatively compare the original LMRv2.1 ensemble to the reproduced version.
